notes: Styles 1 and 2 transcribed from the RESCO page itself, which presents them as the styles found for Carrier-brand units; they are shipped as RESCO's own styles, not via usesStylesOf, because the page does not state a verbatim reuse rule and the Carrier file does not carry these historical styles. Styles 3, 4 and 5 held: style 3 (1980-1984, letter month + digit year) and style 4 (1970-1979, letter month + digit year) decode only via page chart images, and style 5 (pre-1970, single first digit as year) has no era bound that pins the digit to one year. Shipped shapes do not collide with the held shapes (shipped: 4 digits + letter + 5 digits, and 9 digits; held: letter-digit-letter + 5 digits, letter + 6 digits, 7 digits).

styles.notes: Page states week is 1st-2nd character digits and year is 3rd-4th character digits.
Page states year is 1st-2nd numerical digits and month is 3rd-4th numerical digits.
